skills.name: Entrenched
skills.text: At the end phase of your turn, you can draw three cards, then you stack your character cards.

differenceFromNormal: The ability description of “Entrenched” has been changed from “flip your character card” to “stack your character cards” to reflect the new execution for "skip a turn". Essentially, the ability works the same way.
